title: Uttarakhand State Government Health Scheme (SGHS) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Cashless health scheme for eligible Uttarakhand state government employees, pensioners and dependants.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on Uttarakhand government employment/pension status and current SGHS rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Uttarakhand State Government Health Scheme (SGHS).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
